about_the_game:
STORY

You live in a peaceful village in the outskirts of a magical kingdom, with your two parents and a loving but very rural community. Your village is then ATTACKED by monsters and your parents... they don't make it. In your nightmares the monster that did this is always present.

After all the devastation you are lucky to be adopted by royalty, due to your latent magical potential and something that may have happened between you and Minori, a princess of the powerful and fiery Takeda clan.

Take control of the story and experience the exciting characters and world building,

will you get your revenge?

Features

Step into this this fresh fully voice acted visual novel where you are presented with choices that affect the story. Your actions are all weighed into numerous different endings depending on your choices. You could end up romancing one of the characters in the story and living out a sunset fantasy... or 8 feet under!    

  • Beautiful Art

  • Engaging Story

  • Great Voice Acting

  • Multiple Endings

  • Romanceable Characters

  • Hidden Affection System Based on Player Choices

All of this wonderful experience focuses on immersion with beautiful character art, backgrounds, expressions, and fully fleshed and expressive voice acting.

Remember player, your choices matter.
